method: Meta Ad Library, active ads, country CA, keyword search per clinic name (apify/facebook-ads-scraper run 8ugbGvf9eTmTpkjpB, 25 results per search); only ads run by the clinic's own page are counted, so counts are minimums and 25 means the search hit its cap.
excluded: Unrelated advertisers returned by the searches (for example Terra Nova Medical Clinics for Nova Medical, and beauty and wig sellers for Truly You) are not counted.
